rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for systematic surveillance by cameras or other monitoring equipment.

example.english: The company installed new cameras to strengthen surveillance at the building entrances.
example.traditional: 公司裝咗新鏡頭，加強大廈出入口嘅監控。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zong1 zo2 san1 geng3 tau4 gaa1 koeng4 daai6 haa6 ceot1 jap6 hau2 ge3 gaam1 hung3

rows.note: Use this colloquial police term when officers are tailing or closely watching a suspect as part of an investigation.

example.english: The police kept the suspect under surveillance to see whom he met.
example.traditional: 警方派人跟監個疑犯，睇吓佢同邊個接頭。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 paai3 jan4 gan1 gaam1 go3 ji4 faan2 tai2 haa2 keoi5 tung4 bin1 go3 zip3 tau4

rows.note: Use this formal term for ongoing monitoring of disease occurrence, especially in public-health contexts.

example.english: The Department of Health conducts ongoing surveillance of flu cases to detect outbreaks early.
example.traditional: 衞生署持續監測流感個案，及早發現爆發。
example.jyutping: wai6 sang1 cyu5 ci4 zuk6 gaam1 cak1 lau4 gam2 go3 on3 kap6 zou2 faat3 jin6 baau3 faat3
